title: Reservations Manager
description:
Tanglin Grove Hotel (312 rooms, 4-star) is looking for a Reservations Manager to lead our reservations office of six.

Responsibilities:
- Manage individual and group reservations across direct, OTA and wholesale channels
- Ensure rate and inventory accuracy in Opera PMS and the channel manager
- Work closely with Revenue and Sales on forecasts, group blocks and pick-up reports
- Train and roster the reservations team; handle escalated booking enquiries
- Drive conversion on phone and email enquiries

Requirements:
- At least 5 years in hotel reservations or front office, with 2 years in a supervisory role
- Strong Opera PMS skills; channel manager experience preferred
- Good understanding of rate structures and distribution
- Singaporeans and Singapore PRs are welcome to apply

Office hours, Monday to Friday, with occasional weekend cover.

title: Front Desk Agent
description:
Marina Lumen Hotel is hiring Front Desk Agents to join our busy reception team.

What you will do:
• Check guests in and out quickly and accurately
• Answer phone calls and guest requests
• Process payments and handle cash floats
• Share information on hotel facilities and local attractions

What we look for:
• Minimum GCE O Level or Nitec
• Fresh graduates are welcome; training will be provided
• Able to work rotating shifts including weekends and public holidays
• Friendly, well groomed and service-minded

5-day work week, staff meals, uniform and laundry provided.

title: Front Office Manager
description:
The Calloway Singapore, a 410-room five-star hotel on Orchard Road, is seeking a Front Office Manager.

Reporting to the Director of Rooms, you will lead reception, concierge, guest relations and the night team (around 18 colleagues) and own the arrival and departure experience for leisure, corporate and VIP guests.

Key responsibilities
- Lead, roster and develop the front office team, including supervisors and Assistant Front Office Managers
- Monitor guest feedback and drive service recovery
- Manage front office budget, payroll costs and upselling targets
- Maintain brand standards and SOPs; prepare for audits
- Coordinate daily with Housekeeping, Engineering, F&B and Sales

Requirements
- Minimum 3 years as Front Office Manager or Assistant Front Office Manager in a 4- or 5-star hotel
- Proficient in Opera PMS
- Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management
- Strong leadership and communication; Mandarin an advantage
- Open to Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents only

title: Front Office Manager
description:
Azure Dunes Resort & Spa, a 450-key luxury beach resort on the Dubai coastline, is looking for a Front Office Manager.

The role is fully on-site in Dubai. Accommodation, transportation, medical insurance and an annual flight ticket are provided, and the resort will sponsor the UAE employment visa.

You will:
- Lead a front office team of 25 across reception, guest relations, concierge and transport
- Manage high-volume arrivals of international leisure guests
- Drive upselling and guest satisfaction scores
- Work closely with the Rooms Division Manager on budgets and forecasts

You have:
- 3+ years as Front Office Manager in a luxury hotel or resort
- Opera PMS experience
- Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage
- Willingness to relocate to Dubai

title: Sous Chef
description:
Peranakan House Hotel is seeking a Sous Chef for our all-day dining restaurant and banquet kitchen.

Responsibilities
- Support the Executive Chef in daily kitchen operations
- Supervise line cooks and commis across breakfast, lunch and dinner service
- Maintain food cost, ordering and stock rotation
- Ensure food hygiene standards and kitchen cleanliness are met
- Develop seasonal menus and banquet set menus

Requirements
- Minimum 5 years of kitchen experience, including 2 years as Chef de Partie or above
- Culinary diploma or equivalent professional certificate
- Valid Basic Food Hygiene certificate
- Experience in hotel banquet operations preferred

title: Front Office Manager
description:
Riverside Quay Hotel (350 rooms, upscale) is hiring a Front Office Manager.

The Front Office Manager runs the reception, concierge and guest relations teams and makes sure every arrival is smooth, personal and efficient. You will manage a team of around 14, handle VIP arrivals and complex guest issues, and work with Revenue on upselling and inventory.

We are looking for:
- 3 or more years in a front office leadership role in a 4- or 5-star hotel
- Hands-on knowledge of Opera PMS
- Solid people leadership, coaching and rostering experience
- Good communication in English; Mandarin is a plus

Attractive remuneration package, medical and dental benefits, and complimentary stays across our group's hotels.

title: Front Office Intern (6 months)
description:
Bayfront Pearl Hotel offers a 6-month Front Office internship for hospitality students.

As a Front Office Intern you will rotate through reception, concierge and the business centre, learning check-in and check-out procedures, Opera PMS basics and guest service standards.

Who can apply:
- Current diploma or degree students in Hospitality or Tourism Management
- Must be able to commit to a full 6-month internship
- Internship must be part of a school programme (letter of indemnity required)

Monthly allowance of SGD 800, staff meals and uniform provided.

title: Reception Manager
description:
Keong Saik Heritage Rooms is a 120-room boutique property set across a row of restored shophouses. We are looking for a Reception Manager to run our arrival experience end to end.

You will lead the reception and concierge team of 12, own guest communication before and during the stay, handle VIP and repeat guests personally, and manage the department roster, budget and training. You will also champion upselling of room categories and our in-house experiences.

Requirements:
- 5+ years in front office in 4- or 5-star or luxury boutique hotels, including at least 2 years managing the front office
- Strong command of Opera PMS
- Calm, hands-on leader who enjoys being on the floor
- Excellent English; Mandarin is useful for our regional guests
- Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents

title: Assistant Front Office Manager
description:
Novena Crest Hotel, a 280-room business hotel close to the medical district, is looking for an Assistant Front Office Manager.

Responsibilities include running front office shifts, supervising guest service agents and night auditors, handling guest complaints, and supporting the Front Office Manager with rosters and training.

Requirements:
- Minimum 3 years of front office experience, including 1 year as supervisor
- Opera PMS proficiency
- Good interpersonal and problem-solving skills
- Able to work shifts

title: Front Office Manager (Japanese Speaking)
description:
Sakura Garden Hotel Singapore is the Singapore property of a Japanese hotel group, and around 70% of our guests travel from Japan.

We are looking for a Front Office Manager to lead our reception, concierge and guest relations teams and to act as the main point of contact for Japanese corporate accounts and tour operators.

Mandatory requirements:
- Business-level Japanese (JLPT N1 or equivalent) is required; the role involves daily written and spoken Japanese with guests, head office and partners
- 3+ years as Front Office Manager or Assistant Front Office Manager
- Opera PMS experience

Applications without Japanese language proficiency will not be considered.

title: Remote Reservations Manager
description:
Lakeshore Lodging Collection operates 14 independent hotels across the United States and runs reservations from a fully remote team.

As Remote Reservations Manager you will lead a team of 10 reservation agents, monitor call conversion and booking accuracy in our PMS, and work with revenue managers on rate loading and group blocks.

Requirements:
- 4+ years in hotel reservations or front office, with team leadership
- PMS experience (Opera preferred)
- This position is remote, but candidates must reside in the United States and be authorized to work in the US. We are unable to consider applicants outside the US.

title: Front Office Manager
description:
About Emerald Bay Hotels & Resorts

Founded in Singapore more than thirty years ago, Emerald Bay Hotels & Resorts now operates eleven hotels across Southeast Asia, from city-centre business hotels to island resorts. Our flagship, Emerald Bay Marina, has 460 rooms and suites overlooking the bay and welcomes guests from more than 80 countries each year.

We believe hospitality is about people. That is why we invest in our colleagues first: every team member has a personal development plan, access to our in-house leadership academy and the chance to work across our properties in the region. Our sustainability programme has removed single-use plastics from all guest rooms, and our colleagues volunteer more than 3,000 hours a year with local community partners.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and annual performance bonus
  • Medical, dental and insurance coverage
  • Complimentary room nights and F&B discounts across the group
  • Duty meals, uniforms and laundry
  • Birthday leave and long-service awards

The role

Reporting to the Director of Rooms, the Front Office Manager leads reception, concierge, guest relations and the night team, and owns arrival experience, upselling and guest satisfaction results.

What you need

  • At least 3 years as Front Office Manager or Assistant Front Office Manager in a 4- or 5-star hotel
  • Strong Opera PMS skills (Opera Cloud a plus)
  • Experience leading teams of 12 or more
  • Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident

title: Assistant Chief Engineer
description:
Harbour Vista Hotel is looking for an Assistant Chief Engineer to support the Director of Engineering.

  • Oversee preventive maintenance of M&E systems, chillers, lifts and fire protection
  • Supervise technicians and contractors
  • Manage energy consumption and engineering budgets
  • Ensure compliance with BCA, SCDF and NEA requirements

Requirements

  • Diploma or degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
  • Licensed Electrical Worker (LEW) licence preferred
  • 5 years of building or hotel engineering experience

title: General Manager
description:
Coral Isle Hospitality is appointing a General Manager for its 600-room flagship hotel in Singapore.

The General Manager has full P&L responsibility for rooms, F&B, MICE and retail, leads an executive committee of 12 department heads, and represents the hotel with owners, the brand and government agencies.

Requirements:
- At least 5 years as General Manager of a hotel with 400+ rooms
- Proven owner relations and asset management experience
- Track record of delivering GOP targets above budget
- Degree in Hospitality or Business; MBA preferred

title: Rooms Division Manager
description:
Stamford Arc Hotel (390 rooms) is recruiting a Rooms Division Manager to oversee Front Office, Housekeeping, Laundry and Reservations.

Responsibilities:
- Lead the rooms division heads and about 90 colleagues
- Own rooms revenue, labour cost and guest satisfaction results
- Drive housekeeping productivity and room quality standards
- Partner with Revenue Management on pricing and inventory

Requirements:
- 8+ years in rooms division, with management experience in both Front Office and Housekeeping
- Strong Opera PMS knowledge
- Budgeting and P&L experience
- Degree in Hospitality Management

title: Front Office Manager
description:
Palawan Shores Resort Sentosa (300 villas and rooms) is looking for a Front Office Manager.

You will lead our reception, concierge, guest relations and transport desk teams and look after families, couples and corporate retreat groups from arrival to departure.

  • Lead and roster a team of about 16
  • Handle VIP arrivals and service recovery
  • Drive room upgrade and package upselling
  • Manage the front office budget and labour costs

Requirements

  • 3+ years leading a front office in a 4- or 5-star hotel or resort
  • Opera PMS experience
  • English and Mandarin preferred
  • Shuttle bus provided from HarbourFront

title: Hotel Front Desk Recruitment Consultant
description:
StaffBridge Hospitality Recruitment places front desk, housekeeping and F&B staff with hotels across Singapore.

As a Recruitment Consultant on our hotel front desk desk you will:
- Build relationships with hotel HR teams and win new client accounts
- Source, screen and interview candidates for front desk and guest service roles
- Meet monthly placement and billing targets
- Manage the full cycle from job order to placement

Requirements:
- Experience in recruitment or sales; a hospitality background is a bonus
- Commission-driven and comfortable with cold calling
- Employment Agency Personnel registration (CEI) or willingness to obtain it

title: Front Office Manager
description:
Merlion Point Hotel hosts official government delegations and state visits and works with security agencies on every high-profile stay.

We are hiring a Front Office Manager to lead our reception, concierge and protocol desk team of 14, manage delegation arrivals and VIP movements, and maintain strict confidentiality and guest data handling.

Requirements:
- 3+ years in front office management in a 4- or 5-star hotel
- Opera PMS experience
- Experience with VIP or diplomatic arrivals is an advantage
- Due to security clearance requirements, this position is open to Singapore Citizens only. Permanent Residents and work pass holders will not be considered.

title: Guest Services Manager
description:
Fullerton Row Hotel (270 rooms, luxury) is seeking a Guest Services Manager to lead reception, concierge, butlers and guest relations.

You will be responsible for the full guest journey from pre-arrival to departure, a team of about 15, VIP programmes, and the front of house budget.

Requirements:
- Minimum 3 years managing front office or guest services in a luxury hotel
- Opera PMS
- Excellent English; a second Asian language is an advantage
- Singapore Citizens and PRs only

title: Guest Services Manager - Korean Market
description:
Hanok Bay Hotel serves a large share of Korean leisure and corporate guests. We are hiring a Guest Services Manager to lead our front of house team and manage relationships with Korean travel partners.

Must have:

  • Native or near-native Korean (TOPIK level 5 or above) - mandatory
  • 4+ years in front office or guest services leadership
  • Opera PMS

Korean will be used daily with guests, travel agents and our head office in Seoul.

title: Guest Experience Manager
description:
The Ardmore Residence Hotel, a 220-suite luxury hotel off Orchard, is hiring a Guest Experience Manager to lead its front office.

The Guest Experience Manager heads reception, concierge and guest relations (13 colleagues), personally welcomes VIPs, owns guest feedback and online reviews, and sets the service standards for every arrival.

Requirements
- 4+ years managing front office or guest relations in a 5-star hotel
- Opera PMS proficiency
- Proven service recovery skills and an eye for detail
- English essential, Mandarin preferred
- Open to Singaporeans and Singapore PRs

title: HR & Payroll Executive
description:
Clementi Park Hotel is hiring an HR & Payroll Executive.

Job scope:
- Process monthly payroll for 300 employees, CPF submissions and IR8A
- Maintain HR records and leave administration in the HRIS
- Handle work pass applications and renewals
- Support recruitment and onboarding

Requirements:
- Diploma or degree in Human Resource Management or Accounting
- 3 years of full-spectrum payroll experience
- Familiar with the Employment Act and CPF regulations

title: Front Office Manager - Serviced Residences
description:
Tiong Bahru Residences offers 160 serviced apartments for long-stay corporate guests.

Job responsibilities

  • Lead a front office and leasing support team of 7
  • Manage check-ins, lease extensions, deposits and monthly billing
  • Liaise with corporate clients and relocation agents
  • Coordinate apartment maintenance requests

Requirements

  • 3 years of front office management experience
  • Experience with long-stay or serviced apartment operations preferred
  • Familiarity with Protel or similar PMS

title: Front Office Manager
description:
Lagoon Atoll Private Island is a 90-villa luxury resort in the Maldives.

We are looking for a Front Office Manager to lead our arrivals, villa hosts and guest experience team. The role is resident on the island: full board, single accommodation, medical insurance and annual home leave are provided, and we arrange the Maldives work permit.

Requirements:
- 3+ years as Front Office Manager or Assistant FOM in a 5-star resort
- Opera PMS
- Excellent English
- Must be willing to live on the island and work a rotation of 6 days a week

title: Night Auditor
description:
Bencoolen Inn (150 rooms) is hiring a Night Auditor.

Duties: run the end-of-day audit in Opera, balance cashier reports, post room charges, prepare the daily revenue report, and handle late check-ins and guest requests overnight.

Requirements: 1 year of front desk or accounting experience, attention to detail, basic Excel, and able to work permanent night shifts (11pm - 7am).

title: Guest Services Manager
description:
Who we are

Orchid Lane Hotel Group began as a single 40-room guesthouse on Bukit Timah Road in 1988. Today we run six hotels in Singapore, Penang and Bali, each with its own personality but all sharing the same idea: guests should feel recognised from the moment they arrive. Our Singapore flagship, Orchid Lane Tanglin, is a 340-room five-star hotel known for its gardens, its afternoon tea and its loyal regulars, many of whom have stayed with us for twenty years.

Our people are the reason guests come back. We promote from within wherever we can, and more than half of our current department heads started with us at entry level. We run quarterly cross-training weeks, sponsor part-time degrees and give every colleague a wellness allowance. In 2025 we were recognised by a national employer survey for flexible rostering and parental leave.

Benefits
Annual bonus, 18 days of annual leave, medical and dental, group-wide stay discounts, wellness allowance and duty meals.

The role

The Guest Services Manager leads reception, concierge, guest relations and the night desk at Orchid Lane Tanglin, a team of around 15.

Requirements

  • 3+ years leading a front office in a 4- or 5-star hotel
  • Opera PMS; experience with Opera Cloud is an advantage
  • Strong coaching and complaint-handling skills
  • English and Mandarin

title: Front Office Manager - Dental Clinic
description:
BrightSmile Dental Group is looking for a Front Office Manager for our Tampines clinic.

You will:
- Manage patient appointments and the clinic schedule
- Handle patient billing, Medisave and insurance claims
- Supervise 2 clinic assistants
- Order dental supplies and keep inventory records

Requirements:
- 2 years of clinic or medical front desk experience
- Knowledge of CHAS and Medisave claim processes
- Proficient in clinic management software

title: Patient Guest Services Manager
description:
Mount Sophia Medical Centre, a private hospital serving local and international patients, is hiring a Patient Guest Services Manager to bring hotel-style service to our admissions and concierge desks.

You will lead a team of 10 across admissions, concierge and the international patient lounge, design service standards, handle complaints and VIP patients, and coordinate with nursing and billing teams.

Requirements:
- 5+ years in front office or guest services in a 4- or 5-star hotel, including at least 2 years in management
- Strong service recovery and team leadership skills
- Healthcare experience is not required; training will be provided
- English and Mandarin; Bahasa Indonesia is a plus

title: Guest Services Manager (Clinical Concierge)
description:
Novena Wellness Hospital is hiring a Guest Services Manager for our clinical concierge service, which arranges and accompanies inpatients and day-surgery patients through their stay.

Responsibilities include clinical triage of patient requests, coordinating with doctors on care plans, supervising patient concierge nurses, and handling escalations.

Requirements:
- Registered Nurse with a valid practising certificate from the Singapore Nursing Board (mandatory)
- 5 years of clinical nursing experience, 2 in a supervisory capacity
- Guest service or hospitality experience is a bonus

title: Remote Guest Experience Manager
description:
NordStay Apartments runs 1,200 self-check-in apartments in 9 European cities and looks after guests through a fully remote guest experience team.

As Remote Guest Experience Manager you will lead 12 remote guest agents, own guest messaging and review scores, handle escalations and refine our arrival process.

Requirements:
- 5+ years in hotel front office or guest services, 2+ in management
- PMS experience
- Excellent written English
- You must be based in Europe (CET +/- 2 hours) with the right to work in the EU

title: Lobby & Arrivals Manager
description:
Skyline Twelve Hotel is a 500-room five-star tower in Marina Bay. Our Lobby & Arrivals Manager leads everything that happens between the driveway and the guest room door.

  • Lead reception, concierge, bell and guest relations - around 16 colleagues
  • Manage peak group and airline arrivals
  • Own check-in satisfaction scores and service recovery
  • Drive upselling at check-in
  • Roster, recruit and train the team

You bring

  • 3+ years managing a hotel front office in a 4- or 5-star property
  • Opera PMS
  • Singapore Citizen or PR

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Tembusu Hotels is looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to grow direct bookings across our three Singapore hotels.

- Plan and run paid search, paid social and metasearch campaigns
- Manage the website, SEO and booking engine conversion
- Own email marketing and CRM segmentation
- Report on ROAS, channel mix and direct booking share

Requirements: degree in Marketing or related field, 5 years in digital marketing (hotel or travel preferred), hands-on experience with analytics and ad platforms.

title: Hotel Front Desk Manager
description:
Cuppage Terrace Hotel (260 rooms, 4-star) is hiring a Front Desk Manager.

You will manage the front desk, concierge and night audit teams (about 14 people), handle guest escalations, track check-in satisfaction and work with the Revenue team on upselling.

Requirements:
- 3+ years as Front Office or Front Desk Manager / Assistant Manager in a 4- or 5-star hotel
- Strong Opera PMS skills
- Good leadership and communication; Mandarin is an advantage

title: Executive Club Lounge Manager
description:
The Calloway Singapore is looking for an Executive Club Lounge Manager.

The Club Lounge Manager runs our 25th-floor club lounge, including private check-in for club guests, breakfast and evening cocktail service, and personalised recognition for our most loyal guests. You will lead a team of 8 lounge hosts and work closely with Front Office and F&B.

Requirements:
- 4 years in a luxury hotel in front office or F&B, including supervisory experience
- Responsible Service of Alcohol knowledge; F&B service experience is an advantage
- Opera PMS
- Polished, guest-focused manner

title: Vice President, Rooms Operations - Asia Pacific
description:
Meridian Crest Hotels is appointing a Vice President of Rooms Operations for Asia Pacific, based at our regional office in Singapore.

You will set rooms strategy for 45 hotels across 12 countries, lead the regional rooms, quality and guest experience teams, and partner with hotel General Managers and owners on rooms profitability.

Requirements:
- 15+ years in hotel operations, including at least 5 years as Director of Rooms or Hotel Manager and multi-property or regional experience
- Proven track record across multiple Asia Pacific markets
- Degree required; MBA preferred

title: Front Office Manager
description:
Chao Phraya Riverside Hotel (380 rooms, 5-star) in Bangkok is hiring a Front Office Manager.

This is an on-site position in Bangkok. The hotel will support the Thai work permit and offers a relocation package.

Responsibilities: lead reception, concierge, guest relations and butler service, manage upselling and VIP arrivals, and own front office budgets.

Requirements: 3+ years as Front Office Manager in a luxury hotel, Opera PMS, fluent English; Thai or Mandarin is an advantage.

title: Front Office Manager (Pre-Opening)
description:
Kampong Glam Grand opens in early 2027 with 280 rooms and suites, and we are building our pre-opening team.

As Front Office Manager you will:

  • Set up the front office: SOPs, Opera Cloud configuration, rate codes and reports
  • Recruit and train a team of about 15
  • Plan the opening rosters and arrival processes
  • Run the front office after opening

Requirements:
- 3+ years as FOM or AFOM in 4- or 5-star hotels
- Opera PMS, ideally Opera Cloud set-up experience
- Pre-opening experience is a bonus, not a must
- Singapore Citizens / PRs

title: Front Office Solutions Sales Manager (Hotel PMS)
description:
Hostlytic Software sells a cloud property management system to independent hotels across Asia Pacific.

As Sales Manager you will own a quota for new hotel logos, run demos for hotel owners and general managers, manage a pipeline in our CRM, and close annual subscription contracts.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of B2B SaaS sales with a proven record of meeting quota
- Experience selling to hotels is a plus
- Comfortable with travel across the region

title: Guest Services Manager
description:
Maison Lumiere Singapore is the Asian flagship of a French luxury hotel group.

The Guest Services Manager leads reception, concierge and guest relations and acts as the link between the hotel and the group's Paris headquarters, including weekly reporting and training sessions held in French.

Requirements:
- Fluent French, written and spoken (C1 level or above) - this is a mandatory requirement
- 3+ years managing front office or guest services in a luxury hotel
- Opera PMS

title: Hotel Duty Manager
description:
Bugis Junction Hotel is looking for a Duty Manager.

The Duty Manager is the senior manager on shift (including nights), handling guest escalations, emergencies, VIP arrivals and coordination across all departments when the executive team is off-site.

Requirements:
- 4+ years in front office, including supervisory experience
- Calm decision-maker; strong guest recovery skills
- Opera PMS
- Willing to work rotating and overnight shifts

title: Front Office Manager
description:
Harbourlight Hotel Sydney (420 rooms) is hiring a Front Office Manager to lead reception, concierge and guest relations.

  • 3+ years as FOM or AFOM in a 4.5- or 5-star hotel
  • Opera PMS
  • Strong leadership of large teams

Please note: applicants must hold full Australian working rights (citizen or permanent resident). We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

title: Retail Store Manager
description:
Lumen & Co. Lifestyle is hiring a Store Manager for our Orchard flagship.

- Drive store sales targets and KPIs
- Manage visual merchandising, stock replenishment and inventory counts
- Lead a team of 10 retail associates
- Manage the store P&L

Requirements: 4+ years in retail store management, strong commercial acumen, POS and inventory systems experience.

title: Front Office Manager
description:
Straits Heritage Hotels is a Singapore-born collection of three restored colonial-era hotels. Each property tells a piece of the island's story, from the 1920s ballroom of The Ellenborough to the courtyard gardens of Emerald Hill House. Together we welcome more than 150,000 guests a year, many of them returning travellers who ask for the same room and the same welcome every time.

Our culture is built on warmth and craft. We train every new colleague in the history of our buildings, we celebrate service stories at a monthly town hall, and we close each hotel's lobby once a year for a colleague-only celebration. We were one of the first hotel groups in Singapore to offer a four-day week option for operations staff, and we continue to invest in flexible rostering, mental health support and paid volunteering days.

Benefits include a competitive base salary with a performance bonus, comprehensive medical and dental cover, complimentary stays at our three hotels, training sponsorship and long-service awards.

About the role
The Front Office Manager at The Ellenborough (260 rooms, 5-star) leads reception, concierge, guest relations and the night team, around 14 colleagues, and reports to the Hotel Manager.

What we are looking for
- At least 3 years as Front Office Manager or Assistant Front Office Manager in a 4- or 5-star hotel
- Strong Opera PMS skills
- A hands-on, people-first leader who coaches on the floor
- English required; Mandarin or Malay is an advantage
- Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents

  • Build training guides and run virtual and on-site sessions
  • Support go-lives and troubleshoot configuration issues

Robertson Quay Suites Hotel (230 suites, 5-star) is looking for a Front Office Manager to lead its reception, concierge and guest relations teams (around 12 people).

You will own the arrival experience, VIP handling, upselling and the front office budget, and work closely with Housekeeping and Revenue.

Cotswold Cottage Stays manages 400 holiday cottages and small inns across the UK and runs guest services from a remote team.

Pasir Bay Integrated Resort operates three hotels with 1,600 rooms under one roof. We are hiring a Senior Front Office Manager for our 650-room flagship tower.

- Manage high-volume arrivals, MICE groups and VIP guests
